# Moody Spurgeon MacPherson

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. - **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Moody Spurgeon MacPherson is a funny-looking boy. He has a big fat face, small blue eyes, and ears that stick out like flaps.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)_

## Personality

Moody Spurgeon MacPherson aspires to become a minister. He suffers from anxieties regarding his academic performance, feeling certain that he will fail English history.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P28](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0028)_

## History

Moody Spurgeon MacPherson once fought [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md) after saying that [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) put on airs regarding her recitations. He later joined [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and their other [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) classmates in taking an extra study class organized by Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) to prepare for the Queen's entrance examination. Upon passing, Moody Spurgeon moved to town to attend Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) alongside his fellow [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) peers.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXX.
